purpose: Snapshot and compare the public response source and the rendered DOM, including page, template and site-wide findings.

policy.rawSource: The exact HTTP response body saved before JavaScript executes.
policy.renderedDom: document.documentElement.outerHTML after the interactive page reaches ready state.

driftLights.green: Fingerprint and critical detectors match the approved baseline.
driftLights.yellow: The fingerprint changed but the required selector or value still exists; inspect the diff.
driftLights.orange: A critical owner, selector or semantic value changed or conflicts with another owner.
driftLights.red: The public source cannot be captured or the page is not reachable. Saving in WordPress remains possible.

parsed.title: ריינבו תל אביב Rainbow - ישראל קנדה, שדה דב | מחירים ודירות | נדלן

detectors.label: HTTP response and final URL
detectors.rule: 200 response; record redirects and the final URL.

detectors.label: title ownership and length
detectors.rule: Exactly one non-empty title whose project, location and intent match the keyword owner.

detectors.label: meta description
detectors.rule: One buyer-facing answer that exposes apartment selection, plans, view and price intent.

detectors.label: canonical
detectors.rule: Exactly one self-referencing canonical after redirects.

detectors.label: robots directives
detectors.rule: No conflicting meta or HTTP X-Robots-Tag directives.

detectors.label: hreflang cluster
detectors.rule: Reciprocal he/en/fr/ru/ar plus x-default; every target is reachable and canonical.

detectors.label: favicon owners and assets
detectors.rule: One canonical owner emits the icon family; assets are square, crawlable, stable and return 200.

detectors.label: Open Graph and social image
detectors.rule: URL, title, description and image resolve and describe the same project.

detectors.label: structured-data graph
detectors.rule: One owner per entity type; visible facts and IDs agree across WebPage, ApartmentComplex, FAQ and BreadcrumbList.

detectors.label: H1 count, text and location
detectors.rule: One H1; project owner text is present in both raw source and rendered DOM.

detectors.label: breadcrumbs source and schema
detectors.rule: Visible links, BreadcrumbList entities and current page name agree.

detectors.label: duplicate DOM IDs
detectors.rule: No duplicate IDs in raw markup or after modules mount.

detectors.label: cross-project residue and placeholders
detectors.rule: No Ashira, Rainbow, DO or another project identity inside the wrong project; no waiting-copy blacklist.

detectors.label: buyer answer before notices
detectors.rule: The project H1 and opening answer precede internal/legal notices; notices do not become the search-facing lead.

detectors.label: script inventory and order
detectors.rule: Record every src, version, owner and execution mode; detect duplicates, legacy engines and order drift.

detectors.label: window.NADLAN_SHOWROOM contract
detectors.rule: Capture the serialized project contract, version and active project before engine boot.

detectors.label: global menu and navigation destinations
detectors.rule: Compare labels, destinations, active state, keyboard order and mobile menu after render.

detectors.label: footer ownership and global calls to action
detectors.rule: Detect stale project names, duplicated CTA handlers, broken destinations and template drift.

detectors.label: assets, links and endpoints
detectors.rule: Collect href/src/action URLs and attach status, redirect chain, mixed-content and owner.

detectors.label: raw source versus rendered DOM
detectors.rule: Fingerprint the DOM after engine, map, studio and buy flow mount; diff added, removed and moved selectors.

floatingFindings.title: ארבע הצהרות favicon משני בעלים מתחרות באותו head
floatingFindings.effect: Google can choose a different asset or keep a stale icon even though each file itself is reachable.
evidence: View Source L403-L406: WordPress site icon 32x32, 192x192, apple-touch and msapplication tile
floatingFindings.nextAction: Choose one global owner and one stable icon family, preserve the chosen URLs, then request recrawl. Do not patch per project.

floatingFindings.title: הודעת האתר העצמאי נמצאת לפני ה-H1 ולפני כלי הפרויקט
floatingFindings.effect: The first semantic block is a notice rather than the project's buyer answer and can dominate extraction or snippets.
evidence: View Source L1064: .nl-lead → .nl-projnotice → .nl-devlink → progress → feature bar → hidden H1
floatingFindings.nextAction: Keep any required notice internal or later in the decision flow; lead with H1 and the concrete project answer.

floatingFindings.title: חמישה בלוקי JSON-LD כוללים שני FAQPage ושני BreadcrumbList owners
floatingFindings.effect: Facts can drift between graph emitters even when every JSON block parses independently.
evidence: View Source L396 and L401: two FAQPage blocks
View Source L400 plus Yoast graph: BreadcrumbList emitted twice
floatingFindings.nextAction: Build one merged entity graph contract and compare every structured fact with visible content.

floatingFindings.title: העמוד טוען 58 script tags ו-34 style tags
floatingFindings.effect: A large, mixed template surface raises collision, ordering, performance and stale-module risk.
evidence: Full raw source parse: 58 script tags; 34 style tags; 280,817 UTF-8 bytes
floatingFindings.nextAction: Fingerprint src/order/versions and attribute every payload to global, template or component scope before removing anything.

floatingFindings.title: כתובת H-Infinity הישנה מחזירה 404
floatingFindings.effect: Internal cards, menus, schema or search results can send buyers to a dead project route.
floatingFindings.nextAction: Find every source link and choose canonical replacement or redirect at site scope.
